title: Book of Job as a deliberate Mithraic-Kabbalistic text tied to the Achaemenid Magi's restoration of Israel

tellings.quote: And look, now I make a complicated argument for that. In Iranian Leviathan, you have to look at like in the Acemened Persian Empire, who were the Mithraic Magi who were involved with the project of recreating Israel, the first Zionist project in history.

plain: The researcher Jason Jorjani argues that the Book of Job was written on purpose as a coded mystical text, tied to the Magi, the priests of the god Mithra in the ancient Persian Empire of the Achaemenid kings. He tells Michels that these Magi took part in rebuilding Israel, which he calls "the first Zionist project in history," and that he makes "a complicated argument" for this in his book Iranian Leviathan. If he is right, a book of the Bible would carry a hidden Persian religious design.
